what_it_is: The card is a naturalist's field guide and the recipient is the species. Plates, mock-Latin names, range maps, margin notes and 'sightings' turn their habits and obsessions into observations, so it reads as affectionate study rather than a joke at their expense.
best_for: Partner, parent, grandparent, or an outdoorsy or quietly funny friend
tone_fit: Warm, dry, affectionate. Roast only in a gentle 'observed with concern' voice.
lineage: Direction D (field-guide variant) · earlier Field Guide board

what_it_is: The card boots like a device: a startup sequence, a 'system profile' of the recipient, diagnostics, stamped documents and a big deploy button at the end. Mock-serious, tactile and quick.
best_for: Friends and colleagues of tech-minded, gamer or deadpan-humour recipients
tone_fit: Roasty to dry, always affectionate. For a warm ending, drop the machine voice in the last scene.
lineage: Jordan.EXE (Boot Gate, Incident, Launch) · Direction A · earlier Firmware look

what_it_is: The card is a quest journal from an adventure game. The birthday is a quest chain, the recipient is the hero with stats and an inventory, and each scene is a quest or a dialogue with a reward at the end.
best_for: Kids and teens who game, tabletop and fantasy fans, milestone birthdays framed as levelling up
tone_fit: Playful and warm. Roast lightly through the stat sheet.
lineage: Direction D · earlier Quest look · echoes Jordan.EXE achievements

what_it_is: The card is a keepsake box. Open the lid and lift out objects one at a time: a folded note, a ticket stub, a photo to turn over, a pressed leaf. It impresses through care rather than spectacle, and is just as rich with no photos, using designed objects and type.
best_for: Parents, partners, grandparents, close friends, quiet personalities
tone_fit: Warm, thoughtful, sincere. A gentle joke is fine; no roast.
lineage: Direction C · earlier Memory Box board

what_it_is: The card is a stack of bold posters. Saturated colour blocks, giant numerals, cut-out shapes and oversized type make each scene something you would want to screenshot and share.
best_for: Outgoing friends, milestone birthdays, music lovers, anyone who would post it
tone_fit: Exuberant and celebratory. Roast lightly. Put sincere moments in the last scene with the volume turned down.
lineage: Direction B · earlier Technicolour board

what_it_is: The card is a mixtape: a cassette, record sleeve or playlist screen with a hand-lettered J-card, a tracklist where every section is a track, and liner notes from the giver. Sound leads: a made-for-them song, a Side B, beat pads and a real voice.
best_for: Music-obsessed friends, siblings and partners; families with a shared playlist
tone_fit: Warm and cheeky, sincere in the liner notes
lineage: Jordan.EXE (Mixtape, C-MUSIC) · earlier Mixtape look

what_it_is: The card is an arcade cabinet in attract mode. Insert a coin to begin, pick a level, play tiny games, and finish on a high-score table with the recipient's name at the top. Chunky pixels, chip-tune beeps and big 'PLAYER 1' energy.
best_for: Gamers of any age, kids who like simple games, retro-loving adults, siblings and friends
tone_fit: Playful and cheeky, warm at the high-score table
lineage: Earlier Cartridge look · echoes Jordan.EXE tap and timing games

what_it_is: The card is a sports broadcast and match programme: a pre-game show, line-up, stats, instant replay and a final score, with the recipient as the star player. Bold condensed type, scoreboards and a ticker keep the energy up.
best_for: Sports fans, team-mates, coaches, competitive friends and family, retirements
tone_fit: Hyped and cheeky. Roast through 'stats', finish with a warm final whistle.
lineage: Earlier Stadium look

what_it_is: The card is a comic book issue. Panel grids, caption boxes, speech bubbles and sound-effect lettering tell the recipient's story with the giver's voice in the captions, ending on a 'to be continued' teaser for their next year.
best_for: Kids and teens who love cartoons, friends with running jokes, milestones told as an origin story
tone_fit: Playful and adventurous. Roast lightly, and make the last panel sincere.
lineage: Earlier Comic look · echoes S08 Comic Strip

what_it_is: The card is a picture book read aloud. Each scene is a spread with one big illustration, two or three short lines and a refrain that keeps coming back, then a page turn. Made for a grown-up and a small child to share, and for the child to tap through alone.
best_for: Parents, grandparents and older siblings giving to a child of 3 to 8; first birthdays
tone_fit: Warm, gentle, silly. Never sarcastic.
lineage: Earlier Little Legend look · Direction D (the friendly mission for a child)

what_it_is: The card is a sticker book. Each page has a tray of glossy die-cut stickers, washi tape and doodles. The recipient peels and places them (or they land on their own) to build a collage of their favourite things, and every sticker hides a message.
best_for: Kids and tweens who collect things, crafty friends and relatives, any card heavy on small facts and light on photos
tone_fit: Sweet, silly, encouraging. No roast.
lineage: New · echoes S50 Achievements Unlocked and S43 Coupon Book

what_it_is: The card is a newspaper: a front page and inside pages with a masthead, a banner headline about the recipient, columns, classifieds, a crossword and a forecast. The giver is 'the editor'.
best_for: Colleagues, friends, siblings and adult children of newspaper readers; retirements and milestone birthdays
tone_fit: Deadpan and affectionate, with a warm editor's note
lineage: New · Bench idea 'Breaking News & Forecast', returned as a theme

what_it_is: The card is a film premiere: a marquee, a red-carpet arrival, a poster and stills for every 'scene', and end credits. The recipient is the lead in their own feature and the giver is the director.
best_for: Film lovers, friends and partners who enjoy drama, big-milestone birthdays
tone_fit: Dramatic, playful and a little grand. Sincere in the credits.
lineage: New · echoes S05 Movie Trailer Opener

what_it_is: The card is a night drive through a neon-lit synthwave world: a glowing horizon grid, chrome and neon-tube lettering, a dashboard radio, and a road that carries the recipient from scene to scene. Music-led and nostalgic.
best_for: Music-loving friends, 30 to 50 nostalgics, teens who like retro-futurism, travellers
tone_fit: Cool, nostalgic and playful. Sincere at the last stop.
lineage: New

what_it_is: The card is a set of engineering drawings: blueprint sheets with dimension lines, callouts, a title block and a revision table that describe the recipient as a well-engineered marvel. Precise, dry and secretly affectionate.
best_for: Engineers, makers, architects and DIY fans; dry-humour friends, colleagues and partners
tone_fit: Dry, precise and secretly affectionate
lineage: Earlier Lab look (technical and dry) · new drawing-sheet format

what_it_is: The card is a travel passport and journal. Each scene is a destination: a stamp lands on a page, a postcard or boarding pass unfolds, and a route line joins the places that matter in the recipient's life. The journey ends at 'home'.
best_for: Travellers, expats, couples and long-distance friends, retirees with stories
tone_fit: Warm, wry and a little wistful
lineage: New · echoes S25 Departure Board

what_it_is: The card is a fairground at night. A ticket booth at the gate, striped tents, prize counters and side-shows: each scene is a booth with a short game or a barker's pitch, and the prizes are the messages. Warm bulbs, sign-painter lettering and a Ferris wheel finale.
best_for: Kids and families, party-mad friends, anyone who loves games, prizes and warm nostalgia
tone_fit: Warm, cheeky and a bit theatrical
lineage: New

what_it_is: The card is a case file. A folder opens on evidence, witness statements, redacted pages and photographs pinned to a board as 'investigators' (the giver and friends) build a profile of a person of interest. It ends with the case closed: guilty of being loved.
best_for: Colleagues, flatmates, friends and siblings who enjoy deadpan, and mystery fans
tone_fit: Deadpan and noir-flavoured, warm at the verdict
lineage: Earlier Agent look · echoes Jordan.EXE Incident and Decree

what_it_is: The card is a small museum show. Each scene is a room or a wall of framed pieces with wall labels, and the recipient's life is the collection: objects, photos, quotes and pieces of 'art' with a curator's notes. Quiet, elegant and generous with white space.
best_for: Parents, grandparents and partners; milestone retrospectives; photo-rich family cards; anyone who dislikes loud
tone_fit: Warm, tasteful and gently witty. Sincere labels.
lineage: New · Bench idea 'Museum Exhibit', returned as a theme

what_it_is: The card is a menu for a special evening in the recipient's honour. A tasting menu takes them through courses, from amuse-bouche to dessert. Each dish is a story or a memory, with a chalkboard of specials, a waiter's notes, and a bill at the end that reads 'paid in full by everyone who loves you'.
best_for: Foodies, home cooks, coffee and baking fans; partners, families and dinner-party friends
tone_fit: Warm, witty and a little indulgent
lineage: New · Bench idea 'Tasting Menu', returned as a theme
